The Club TimesIssue 3 · March 2026

Junior band takes the stage

Twelve members, eight weeks, one standing ovation.

Photo: the junior band

Eight Saturdays ago most of them had never held a drumstick. On the 14th the junior band opened the showcase with two songs and an encore the audience asked for.

"We practised the hard bar until it was boring," said the drummer. Their instructor kept a chart of every rehearsal on the music-room wall.
